title: Birbal and the Impossible Task
moral: Good and bad times do not last forever.

scenes.summary: Akbar gives Birbal a challenging task.
scenes.text: One day, Emperor Akbar asked Birbal to bring something that could make him both happy and sad.
scenes.image_prompt: king giving challenge to birbal in court, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Birbal thinks about the difficult task.
scenes.text: Birbal thought carefully about how to solve the unusual problem.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal thinking deeply with thoughtful expression, cartoon

scenes.text: The next day, Birbal brought a ring with a special message written on it.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal presenting ring to king in royal court, cartoon

scenes.summary: Akbar reads the message on the ring.
scenes.text: Akbar read the words “This too shall pass” written on the ring.
scenes.image_prompt: king reading ring with thoughtful expression, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Birbal explains the meaning and Akbar is pleased.
scenes.text: Birbal explained that both happiness and sadness are temporary. Akbar was pleased. Good and bad times do not last forever.
scenes.image_prompt: king smiling in understanding while birbal stands beside, cheerful cartoon

story: One day, Emperor Akbar asked Birbal to bring something that would make him happy when sad and sad when happy. Birbal brought a ring with the words “This too shall pass.” He explained that both happiness and sadness are temporary. Akbar was pleased with the wise answer.
